explanation: This file contains a concrete reference design and a selected algorithm excerpt for Range Analytics Engine. The project remains draft until all required features are implemented, tests are run, and the rubric is reviewed. Prefix sum query O(1) but point updates O(n); Fenwick/segment point updates and range queries O(log n); lazy range update/query O(log n).
reference_architecture: Start with a brute-force baseline and repeated-query tests; then compare prefix sums, Fenwick tree, and segment tree under the update/query mix.
algorithm_approach: The protected `SegmentTree` and `LazySegmentTree` exercise solutions provide reference range-sum and range-add patterns. Benchmark the same synthetic workload and verify each result against a plain list.
complexity_targets: Prefix sum query O(1) but point updates O(n); Fenwick/segment point updates and range queries O(log n); lazy range update/query O(log n).
